entities.name: Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization Procedure
entities.description: Procedure enabling AAA-S via NSSAAF to (re-)authenticate or (re-)authorize UE upper layers for HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI using EAP protocol.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message transporting EAP-request from network to UE as part of network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message transporting EAP-response from UE to network as part of network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: Message transporting EAP-success or EAP-failure from network to UE as part of network slice-specific result message transport procedure.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from network to UE containing authentication request.

entities.name: EAP-response message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from UE to network in response to EAP-request.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating successful authentication completion.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating unsuccessful authentication completion.

entities.name: T3575
entities.description: Timer used for reliable transport of EAP messages in network slice-specific authentication procedure.

entities.name: Authentication completes successfully
entities.description: Condition where UE (re-)authentication completes successfully, triggering EAP-success message.

entities.name: Authentication completes unsuccessfully
entities.description: Condition where UE (re-)authentication completes unsuccessfully, triggering EAP-failure message.

entities.name: No EAP layer retransmissions in AMF
entities.description: Property where authenticator retransmission timer is set to infinite value due to reliable transport of EAP messages.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Procedure includes sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
Procedure includes sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message transports EAP-request message.
AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message transports EAP-response message.
AUTHENTICATION RESULT message transports EAP-success message when authentication succeeds.
AUTHENTICATION RESULT message transports EAP-failure message when authentication fails.
Sending AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message starts timer T3575.
Receiving AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message stops timer T3575.
Successful authentication condition establishes EAP-success message transmission.
Unsuccessful authentication condition establishes EAP-failure message transmission.
Procedure establishes property of no EAP layer retransmissions due to reliable transport.
